groups.facts: One sectional fastened joint: TWO horizontal plates overlap around ONE central vertical fastener. Upper plate extends farther left, lower plate farther right. Upper/lower plate regions and central fastener section carry diagonal material hatching. The fastener passes through both plate thicknesses, with rounded enlarged top and bottom ends. At the plate contact level, the fastener section remains continuous. No additional fastener, hole, scale, numerical size or material label.

Two solid horizontal arrows act in opposite directions at different plate heights: vector -F points left from the upper plate's left edge; vector F points right from the lower plate's right edge. Labels preserve the minus sign and vector notation. No extra shear-plane arrow, crack, detached part or numeric stress is printed.
